label: Whatever has a good-general favouring apprehends some content
paraphrase: OPEN cognition criterion, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every bearer x that has the real determination that a favouring of it is a good-general profile phi (for at least one pair of candidates, at least one not a present input, its favouring depends on their betterness, read as value, with end-realization held fixed) itself apprehends some content that is about some candidate. It is a direct assumption whose content is the thesis that responsiveness of favouring to the value of non-present candidates is cognition; it is stated without reference to persons and applies in the same way to rational exercise and to an impersonal good-general nature. At a root before production nothing is a present input, so there it rests on the value-dependence mark alone. The value reading is load-bearing: with lower action as the ranking, a least-action law meets the formal definition (CriterionTable row 5). The impersonal good-general rival affirms what the criterion denies: that a noncognitive favouring can depend on the value of non-present candidates. With About and Apprehends free, this criterion and the recognition bridge together amount to one thesis.
